final.summary: The batch’s treatment interval shows ETP inflow and tank level consistent with water passing through the plant and water balances close, but an accredited lab grab sample at 21:55 on 13 Oct shows BOD 102.6 mg/L, well above the 30 mg/L limit. Outfall pH and power are missing from 14:00 13 Oct to 01:45 14 Oct, so aeration during the critical early part of the interval cannot be verified from the feed.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
